event: IEB web archive contains event and music-related publications.

A contemporary November 2013 IEB announcement explicitly refers to the INFOEVENTBAND.COM online competition held the previous year, confirming a 2012 edition. The same archive also records a 2012 contributor trip to Ujung Genteng, Sukabumi. Exact 2012 competition dates and participant list are not yet reconstructed.
A contemporary third-party publication documents IEB supporting an event in Depok, attending for documentation, and distributing IEB 2013 calendars.
IEB's SoundCloud account publishes a compilation track and describes it as originating from songs selected from hundreds of indie bands through the Ajang Music Charts program.

IEB documented Ajang Music Charts Part 5 and recorded Habibi Sank with 'Ibu' as the highest-voted winner. Exact voting-end date is not retained here until a direct contemporary Part 5 source is verified.
Contemporary syndicated material documents IEB's Music Charts, online competition, event support, band promotion, submission channels, and contributor activity.
A first-party retrospective states that IEB served as media support for a singing competition and that its administrator represented IEB as a judge.
A first-party journal retrospectively documents the transition from Reflexion Management and ReflexionPromosindo.com toward InfoEventBand.com and identifies its administrator.
